The implementation proceeds in five phases. Phase one fixes three blocking bugs in the prose navigation system: substrate misclassification where all entries are tagged as Code, frontmatter bleed where YAML metadata corrupts heading names, and missing prose collections in the URI parser.

Phase two updates the architecture decision records. ADR-017 is superseded by ADR-022. ADR-015 and ADR-016 receive status updates reflecting the current implementation state of the natural language query pipeline.

Phase three adds technical documentation test fixtures to validate aq-nlp against ADR-like text before integration. The existing test corpora cover fiction and encyclopedic prose but not technical specifications or architectural documents.

Phase four addresses the tree-sitter Dart grammar coverage gap. The bgc_server and innovative_access projects use sealed classes and enhanced enums that the current parser cannot handle.

Phase five wires aq-nlp into canopy behind the feature gate, implementing the two-tier pipeline with pulldown-cmark as the structural foundation and spaCy-backed entity extraction as the enrichment overlay.
